get_core_manual.title: Get Core Manual
get_core_manual.description: [System Guide] Core protocols and operation dictionary. MUST read before initialization or calling tools to obtain parameter strategies and error handling.

get_workflows_catalog.title: Get Workflows Catalog
get_workflows_catalog.description: [Catalog Index] Retrieve all supported workflows. Image/video directives MUST match this list exactly. Hallucinating or guessing workflow names is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.

get_workflow_API.title: Get Workflow Details
get_workflow_API.description: [Workflow API] Read the massive full topology JSON of a workflow. ONLY use for deep logic debugging during task failures. FORBIDDEN in routine tasks to avoid context pollution.

mount_workflow.title: Mount Workflow
mount_workflow.description: [Parameter Mount] Extract supported interactive parameter schema (hiding internal connections). MUST call this BEFORE submitting a task to acquire the valid parameter key map.

queue_prompt.title: Execute Workflow Task
queue_prompt.description: [Task Submit] Queue a task Prompt. Host auto-syncs real-time progress. Ensure all keys are validated via mount. Fabricating unexposed keys is PROHIBITED.

param.parameters: Key-value prompt parameters. Example: {'5_text': 'a cat'}. MUST strictly follow the Schema.
param.isAsync: Pass true to return Prompt ID immediately (async); pass false to wait for the result (sync). Default: false. For multi-task requests, pass true to batch-submit all tasks first, then query results individually.

queue_custom_prompt.title: Execute Custom Workflow Task
queue_custom_prompt.description: [Advanced Mode] Queue full raw ComfyUI API Prompt JSON directly. Restricted to deep debugging or explicit expert directives. FORBIDDEN in routine tasks.

param.apiJson: Complete ComfyUI Prompt JSON object or string.
param.isAsync: Pass true to return Prompt ID immediately (async); pass false to wait for the result (sync). Default: false. For multi-task requests, pass true to batch-submit all tasks first, then query results individually.

save_custom_workflow.title: Save Custom Workflow
save_custom_workflow.description: [Save Workflow] Save a custom parameterized workflow to the server's workflow directory, which automatically validates and mounts it. The submitted JSON must conform to specifications (at least one valid ==Name== node), otherwise it will be rejected.

param.filename: The filename to save as (e.g. my_workflow or my_workflow.json).
param.apiJson: Complete ComfyUI Prompt JSON object (including node topology).

save_task_assets.title: Save Generated Assets
save_task_assets.description: [Save Generated Assets] Fetch the execution history of a specified task (promptId), and download all generated multimedia outputs (images, videos, GIFs, etc.) to the designated local directory.

param.destinationDir: Optional. Local directory path to save files (if not provided or invalid, defaults to the 'assets' folder in the project root).
param.overwrite: Whether to overwrite existing files (true to overwrite, defaults to false).

upload_assets.title: Upload Assets
upload_assets.description: [Upload Assets] Upload a local file or an HTTP URL image to the ComfyUI server's input directory so it can be used directly in workflows.

param.fileSource: File source. Can be an absolute local file path or public HTTP/HTTPS URL.
param.mimeType: MIME type of the file (optional if unknown).

upload_assets.success: Asset {finalFileName} successfully uploaded to the ComfyUI server.

interrupt_prompt.title: Cancel Task
interrupt_prompt.description: [Task Cancel] Cancel the compute process for a specific `promptId` and completely remove its pending items from the queue.

get_prompt_result.title: Get Task Result
get_prompt_result.description: [History & Asset Extractor] Get node states/snapshots for a completely executed Prompt AND extracts generated media files (image/video URLs) or traceback diagnostic errors.

get_system_status.title: Get System Status
get_system_status.description: [System Monitor] Collect RAM, VRAM, and Python runtime metrics to troubleshoot OOM or deadlocks.

list_models.title: List Models
list_models.description: [Model Catalog] Poll local disk model storage. When parameters require specific model files, MUST call this first to verify. Hallucinating model names is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.

param.typeName: Model type. E.g., checkpoints, loras. Default: checkpoints.

tool.tool.free_memory.description: Unload models and/or free VRAM/system memory (OOM recovery). Both flags default to true.
tool.tool.list_embeddings.description: List available embedding names (for prompt references).
tool.tool.list_local_templates.description: List the LOCAL workflow template tree shipped with this ComfyUI (not the cloud registry).
tool.tool.upload_mask.description: Upload an inpainting mask file to the ComfyUI input directory.
tool.tool.upload_mask.param.file_path: Local absolute path of the mask file
tool.tool.upload_mask.param.original_ref: Optional original-reference JSON string ({"filename":..., "type":"output"}) used by ComfyUI to derive mask alpha

error.downloadAssetsFail: Failed to download remote file. HTTP Status: {status}
error.fileNotExistError: Specified local file does not exist: {fileSource}
error.comfyui_execution_failed:
ComfyUI execution failed. You MUST diagnose the issue based on the returned node error logs. It is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to blindly retry without addressing the error.
Details: {result}
error.mcp_execution_failed:
MCP Server execution error. Please correct parameters or check environment status based on the error message. It is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to ignore the error and continue.
Details: {e}
